'''Michael McMillan''' is a voice actor for the English dub of {{aniseries|PTS}}.

==Biography==
McMillan became a voice actor sometime as an adult. He joined the {{pkmn|animated series}} during {{aniseries|SM}}, where he gained his first role, voicing [[island kahuna]] [[Nanu]]. McMillan currently lives in New York.
